name: pack_qkv_destination_major
description: Pack q, k and v from matching [rows,global_heads,head_size] tensors. Split the heads into world_size equal groups and concatenate each rank's q, k and v along the last dimension. The result is [world_size,rows,global_heads/world_size,3*head_size]. If out is a compatible contiguous tensor, write to it and return that same buffer. If out is None, allocate and return a new tensor. The alias is conditional on out being a tensor.
